title: Standing approval: a criterion only the landing can satisfy does not block a fully validated changeset
outcome: Standing approval: a criterion only the landing can satisfy does not block a fully validated changeset
acceptance: The staged changeset holds byte-identical AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md wording, in the standing approval's acceptance-criteria condition, saying that a criterion only the landing itself can satisfy (the change being committed, pushed, on master or installed) does not block a changeset that meets every other condition; and that the landing and its post-landing evaluation must then make it true before completion

Every existing safeguard is unchanged: the gate or Markdown-only checks, the two-vendor review condition, host-observed criterion evidence, scope, readiness and migration, rebase and history-rewrite limits, and the restart rules

Both coordinators' concurrence (Engram::Fable and Termal::Fable2) on the exact wording is recorded on this item; Greg was sent the exact wording and its consequence; and, because this widens agent authority, Greg's explicit verbatim approval of that wording is recorded with its source
The final-diff audit that /review-changes requires is recorded on this item as passed; the Markdown-only checks pass; and a Codex and a Claude review find no in-scope Medium or higher

completion.summary: Delivered the exact Greg-approved landing-only acceptance clause identically in AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md; committed and fast-forward pushed the reviewed tree, built the clean landed source, verified all six live stores ready before and after commit, and installed it without stopping running processes.
